VERDICT: FAIL

BASIS: WIT

The third-party reviewer note (WIT class evidence) directly contradicts the self-report by identifying that structured audit logging is absent, despite being an explicit acceptance criterion. While the CI log (ATT class) confirms tests pass, it cannot verify the presence of audit logging functionality—only that tests executed successfully. The witness observation of missing audit logging is the most reliable evidence here and takes precedence over the self-report's claim of complete implementation.
